blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Construction has begun on the Philippines’ first purpose-built port for offshore wind development, marking an initial infrastructure step toward building out the country’s offshore wind sector. The Philippine Ports Authority, local government units in Camarines Norte and private sector partners broke ground on Friday on the 40-hectare Pambuhan Marshalling Port. READ: Offshore wind […]...
